name: genotype-workbench
description: Local-first genotype workbench: bring your raw DNA file, explore it on a genome view, enrich it with whole downloaded packs.

scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build crates/locus-wasm --target web --release --out-dir pkg --out-name locus_wasm
scripts.dev: pnpm build:wasm && pnpm build:ext && pnpm --filter @gw/web dev
scripts.build: pnpm build:wasm && pnpm build:ext && pnpm --filter @gw/web build
